map.输入泵流量、工作压力、系统效率与允许温升，按经验法则与热平衡计算油箱容积、散热面: From pump flow, working pressure, system efficiency and allowable temperature rise, size the hydraulic reservoir volume and heat-dissipation area and judge whether a cooler is needed.
map.💡 液压功率 Ph=p·Q/60；发热功率 H=Ph·(1-η)；所需散热面积: 💡 Hydraulic power Ph=p·Q/60; heat power H=Ph·(1-η); required heat area A=H/(K·ΔT); tank volume V=multiple·Q
map.容积倍数：行走机械 2~3min，固定设备 3~5min，高压大流量取大值: Volume multiple: mobile machinery 2~3 min, stationary 3~5 min, high-pressure large-flow use larger
map.散热系数 K：自然冷却 10~15，风冷 20~30，水冷 100~200 W/: Heat-transfer coefficient K: natural cooling 10~15, air cooling 20~30, water cooling 100~200 W/m²·°C
map.油箱长宽高比例建议 3:2:1，液位高度约为油箱高的 0.8: Tank length:width:height ratio suggested 3:2:1; fluid level about 0.8 of tank height
map.稳态温升超允许值时需加装冷却器，发热量大时强制冷却: When steady temperature rise exceeds the allowed value, add a cooler; with high heat, force cooling
map.按泵流量定油箱容积与回油缓冲。: Set tank volume and return buffer by pump flow.
map.泵流量 100 L/min、系数 3~5 → 油箱 V≈300~500 L，保油: Pump flow 100 L/min, factor 3~5 → tank V≈300~500 L, enough oil with margin for heat and settling.
map.长:宽:高≈3:2:1 布置，回油与吸油隔开防气泡吸入。: Lay out length:width:height≈3:2:1; separate return and suction to avoid bubble ingestion.
map.常用泵流量 3~5 倍（分钟），行走机械可更小，固定站取大助散热。: Commonly 3~5× pump flow (minutes); mobile can be smaller, stationary larger for cooling.
map.避免回油气泡直入泵、促气泡与杂质上浮沉淀，护泵延寿。: Avoid return bubbles entering the pump directly; let bubbles and debris float and settle, protecting the pump and extending life.
map.液压油箱设计工具综合经验法则与热平衡法，输入泵流量、工作压力、系统效率与允许温升: The hydraulic tank design tool combines rules of thumb and heat balance. Input pump flow, working pressure, system efficiency and allowable rise to compute hydraulic power, heat power, tank volume (by multiple rule), dimensions and heat area, judge whether natural cooling suffices and give cooler power need. It applies to hydraulic-power-unit tank design.
map.液压站油箱容积设计: Hydraulic power unit tank volume design
map.系统热平衡与冷却器选型: System heat balance and cooler selection
map.液压油箱容积与发热散热设计（本页代码口径，容积按倍数法）：液压功率 Ph=压力: Hydraulic tank volume and heat dissipation design (page code basis; volume by the multiple method): hydraulic power Ph = pressure p×flow q÷60 (kW), heat power H = Ph×(1−η)×1000 (W, η overall system efficiency); tank volume V = volume multiple vm×pump flow q (L), residence time = V÷q (min); with a 3:2:1 box, s=(V÷1000÷6)^(1÷3), length=3s, width=2s, height=s, actual heat-dissipation area=16s²; required area = H÷(dissipation coefficient K×allowed temperature rise ΔT), steady-state rise under natural cooling = H÷(K×actual area), thermally balanced volume = 6×√(required area÷16)³×1000 (L). Validation: six parameters must be valid numbers with q, p, ΔT, K and multiple >0 and η∈(0,1), otherwise each reports and stops. Verdict: actual area < required means a cooler is needed (cooling power = (H−K×actual area×ΔT)÷1000 kW); steady-state rise ≤ΔT means natural cooling suffices; residence time <2 min prompts it is too short and suggests a larger volume multiple.
